theorems.name: Submission.dorag_ha_pb_variance_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (s : Set (Euclid n)) (f : Euclid n → ℝ), volume s ≠ ∞ → MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict s) → ∫ x in s, (f x - (∫ y in s, f y) / (volume s).toReal) ^ 2 ≤ ((volume s).toReal)⁻¹ * ∫ x in s, ∫ y in s, (f x - f y) ^ 2
